items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: It was the Oliver band essentially, but... Essentially, it was really the Russell band

ctx.x: I have never even heard it. I don't know... See, I didn't ever know the titles of the numbers. We'd record things, and I'd never know what the title is until the number come out.
And later, under Oliver's name, you also made "West End Blues," "I've Got That Thing"...
"West End Blues" was made under King
